items.html: *And know that these four Mochin that are in this Tzelem are the secret of the four Yudin that are in the name HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin of Aba, for from there they were drawn, and they are the Mem of Tzelem. Also this Mem of Tzelem, which is called the complete Tzelem, since the phase of the lower ones is also included in it, this phase is called Avir [air], for they have not yet truly entered within the body of ZA itself, but stand only in the secret of Ohr Makif [encompassing light] as mentioned above, and are called Avir.
